hero.title: Energy Efficiency for Data Centers.
description: Energy efficiency for Data Centers is directly linked to airflow management to eliminate hotspots. This technique can save up to 75% of the cooling budget. Consultimer develops solutions to fill gaps where airflow leakage occurs, using customized parts such as: Blanking panels, HACs (Hot Aisle Containment), CACs (Cold Aisle Containment), and connectivity pathways.

offerings.title: Optimizing airflow management within a data center is the first step toward energy efficiency

items.title: Blanking Panels
paragraphs: Blanking panels are components that prevent the reuse of exhaust air from the machines. This device prevents equipment from overheating.
Consultimer's specialized team can install a blanking panel in up to 5 seconds; this way, companies can achieve an optimized data center in a matter of hours.

items.title: HACs (Hot Aisle Containment) and CACs (Cold Aisle Containment)
paragraphs: Hot and cold aisle containment systems work to cool equipment by allowing cold air to enter without mixing with hot exhaust air.
